subject: HIT-86

materialized_result.summary: Локальный надёжный приём проверенного Stripe-сигнала: fsync ограниченного JCS-сообщения до короткой SQL-транзакции signals+outbox, повторы/квоты/восстановление без ложного успеха.

verification.environment: Go1.27.2 darwin/arm64; pgx5.11.0/JCS1.0.2; exact PostgreSQL18.7 Alpine in owned sandbox; synthetic events and temporary workspace-only content roots
verification.results: All six commands exit0: unit -race (132 PASS test/subtest events), integration -race (164 PASS including existing unit tests), vet, build, modules, 377 SQL checks. No failures/skipped tests. Clean source at invocation, hashes unchanged at completion; owned containers removed.
verification.coverage: Durable file before SQL; JCS bytes/digest readback; sequential/concurrent cross-instance retries; connection/workspace separation; RLS and scope/lease reset; invalid/revoked/unknown connection; rollback/orphan and cleanup exclusion; true loopback PG COMMIT response loss after server commit; fresh pool/root handle recovery; concurrent count and byte quotas; expiry, EXPIRED and unavailable content; all three OAS event types with no payment decision.
verification.evidence_presentation: Compact factual transcript replaces oversized TEST evidence for review budget; raw logs and original registration/history preserved; code/tests unchanged.

known_limitations: No public HTTP webhook, sender, real Processing, IAM/runtime authority, Stripe facts, activation or ClickUp action. Outbox is not a Processing acknowledgement.
Tmpfs and local fsync/transport tests do not qualify production disk/power-loss/flush/backup or deployed Stripe-to-ClickUp flow.

Explicit checked connection/clock inputs and workspace-only root remain required; all publishers/cleanup must use the same DB lease. This baseline serializes publication and makes no throughput claim.

One UUIDv4 links existing signal_id/receipt_id/message_id without DDL change; Stripe dedup remains UNIQUE(workspace_id,connection_id,event_id). First age is fixed at whole-second precision and never refreshed on replay.
Dedicated PostgreSQL CVE reproduction/security qualification not performed. Approved18.7 and original DDL retained.
Independent review and human acceptance not performed.
